tier: TIER 1 — scalping — automation preferred but can be done manually
session: NY open only — 15:30–16:00 Oslo (9:30–10:00 AM ET)
direction: LONG only — buy stocks gapping UP with catalyst

rules.gap_minimum: Stock must be gapping more than 4% pre-market
rules.catalyst_required: Every gap must have a confirmed catalyst: earnings, news, PR, FDA approval. No catalyst = skip — do not trade.
rules.float: Only trade low float stocks: under 20 million shares preferred
rules.volume_signal: If more than 10% of float has traded pre-market = high priority
rules.pre_market_high: Mark pre-market high before market opens
rules.entry_primary: Buy break of pre-market high OR high of first 1-minute candle at open
rules.entry_alternative: Red to Green move — stock dips then recovers above previous close
rules.stop_loss: Low of the first 1-minute candle — very tight
rules.take_profit: Sell into the first spike — do not hold more than 30 minutes
rules.position_size: 1% of portfolio per trade — calculate units properly
rules.timeout: If stock does not break pre-market high within first 5 minutes = skip

earnings_rule: Check earnings calendar every morning — any stock reporting earnings that day is a Gap-and-Go candidate regardless of watchlist
